sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Dvergr mages are neutral creatures found in the Mistlands around Dvergr settlements. They resemble short, blue humanoids with light blue eyes and silver hair, and they carry Magic staves. There are three different types of Dvergr mage, which can be differentiated by the color of their staff and robe. Unlike Dvergr rogues, mages are exclusively found around Dvergr settlements and other structures (almost always in groups with other Dvergr) and do not respawn.
Once provoked by a player (by damaging them, other nearby Dvergr, or any part of a nearby structure that is protected by a Dvergr Ward), they will become hostile and attack.
Dvergr are naturally hostile to other aggressive creatures in the Mistlands and will attack them on sight. Clearing at least one Dvergr settlement is typically necessary to progress in the Mistlands, because the Dvergr component crate contains the Dvergr extractor, an essential component in the Sap extractor. This can be circumvented by ramming the relevant crate with a cart or hoping that aggressive mobs in the area destroy it.

sections.heading: Attacks and abilities
sections.text: Due to range requirements, many attacks from every variant of mages are possible to disable by standing directly against the caster. Both the fire mages and the ice mage share a melee attack.

sections.heading: Melee
sections.text: Pokes the player with the hilt of their staff (70 Blunt damage). This is accessible every 4 seconds when within 0.5-2.5 meters of a player. Despite being a straight thrust, this attack hits a horizontal arc 2.5 meters long and 90 degrees across.

sections.heading: Fire mages
sections.text: Fire mages wear a red robe lined with gold and carry a pronged, fiery-red staff. They have two unique attacks:

sections.heading: Fireball
sections.text: Brings their staff around and then sweeps down to launch a single fireball that inflicts the Burning status (130 Fire damage). The fireball travels at 15 meters per second for up to 10 seconds before despawning. It is generated with a spread of 1–10 degrees. This attack can be used every 6 seconds when within a 1–15 meters of a player. If it hits the ground instead of a player, it creates a 6-meter radius circular blast that expands outward (100 Fire damage).

sections.heading: Clusterbomb
sections.text: Waves their staff for a few seconds before raising it up higher to launch a shower of nine fireballs in various directions that inflict the Burning status (100 Fire damage each). Each fireball travels at 11 meters per second for up to 10 seconds before despawning. They originate from a point 2.5 meters off the ground and have a spread of 40–50 degrees. This attack can be used every 35 seconds when within 5–30 meters of a player. On impact with the ground, these fireballs create 3-meter radius circular fields of fire (100 Fire damage).

sections.heading: Ice mages
sections.text: Ice mages wear a blue robe lined with silver and carry a staff tipped with a glowing blue ice shard. They have two unique attacks:

sections.heading: Icebolt
sections.text: Stabs forward with their staff to launch three balls of ice at the player which inflict the Frost status (200 Frost damage). Each ball of ice travels at 15 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 8–15 degrees. This attack can be used every 6 seconds when within 1–15 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Nova
sections.text: Slams their staff down to create an outward expanding circle with a radius of 5 meters, which inflicts the Frost status (100 Frost damage). This attack can be used very 7 seconds when within 0–7 meters of a player.

sections.heading: Support mages
sections.text: Support mages wear a yellow-and-brown robe lined with gold and carry a staff tipped with a Dvergr lantern. They have three unique abilities:

sections.heading: Buff
sections.text: Lifts their staff up before slamming it into the ground to apply the Dvergr power status to themselves and allies within 8 meters for 20 seconds (+20% to all Skills). This ability can be used every 45 seconds when within 1–15 meters of an ally.

sections.heading: Heal
sections.text: Draws a half-circle on the ground before lifting their staff in the air to apply the Dvergr heal status to themselves and allies within 4.32 meters for 4 seconds (400 health ticking every 0.5 seconds). This ability can be used every 10 seconds when within 1–15 meters of an ally.

sections.heading: Mistile
sections.text: Smashes the ground with their staff to create 1–3 Mistiles within a 3-meter radius around the caster; a max of nine can be active at once. These orbs have 1 health and track the player to deal damage on impact (150 Blunt damage). These can be summoned every 35 seconds when within 1–15 meters from a player. The Mistiles themselves deal damage in a 1.5 meter sphere when within 1 meter of the player.
